facts.fact: Armen 报告黑卡办好、账户干净且无有用纸质线索。
facts.anchor: Black card’s done. Properly set up, clean accounts, no paper trail that leads anywhere useful.
The name embossed on the card sits there in clean silver lettering. ‘Christopher Sinclair.’

facts.fact: Armen 指出姓氏的选择耐人寻味。
Soren 认为 Everly 姓氏可能触发 Zero Hour 的警报。
facts.anchor: That surname probably has fucking alarm bells tied to Zero Hour.

facts.fact: Armen 指出可以任选其他普通假姓。
facts.anchor: You could’ve gone with anything. Smith, Jones… some random nothing name.

facts.fact: Soren 问自己为何偏用自己的姓。
facts.anchor: So why the fuck did I use my own?

facts.fact: Soren 让 Armen 知道保险柜密码，仅限自己死亡或重大事故时打开。
facts.anchor: You don’t open this unless I’m dead or something has gone seriously wrong. Understood?

facts.fact: 纸质日志记录某些不宜存入硬盘的事项。
facts.anchor: there are still entries that should never exist on a hard drive.

facts.fact: 不安没有明确威胁、名字或方向。
facts.anchor: There’s no clear threat, no name, no direction I can point to.

facts.fact: 他预感看不见又无法阻止的坏事逼近。
facts.anchor: Something I can’t see yet, and somehow, I already know I won’t be able to stop it. Something bad.

facts.fact: 他感到无法定位的裂缝。
最后落在无法命名的弱点。
facts.anchor: A weakness I can’t name yet.
